title: Linux Home Server Setup
description: Build your own internet-connected server at home. Access it from anywhere in the world using your own domain name, connect securely via SSH, and protect it with a firewall so even if someone breaches your home network, their access is severely limited. No cloud provider, no monthly fees — just your hardware, your rules, full control.

pageEntries.label: Installing Linux
pageEntries.description: Choose how to create your bootable USB drive based on the operating system you are starting from.

variants.label: Starting from Windows (Rufus)
variants.description: Use Rufus on Windows to create the bootable USB drive.

variants.label: Starting from Linux (dd)
variants.description: Use the dd command on Linux to create the bootable USB drive.
